articles.summary: Extended campaign demonstrates feedstock flexibility, process stability and operating continuity while generating engineering and permitting data for the FOAK Facility at Chemelot LONDON, Ontario, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Aduro Clean Technologies Inc . (“ Aduro ” or the “ Company ”) (Nasdaq: ADUR ) (TSX: ACT ) (FSE: 9D5 ), a clean technology company using the power of chemistry to transform lower value feedstocks, like waste plastics, heavy bitumen, and renewable oils, into resources for the 21 st century, today provided an update on continued operating progress at its Next Generation Process (“NGP”) Pilot Plant. The latest NGP campaign ran for approximately 120 hours over a period of five days, the longest reported to date, and marked further progress in the NGP program’s transition from controlled feedstock testing to processing real-world post-consumer plastic waste.
